svg.text: D06 | Cleared latch bridge and adjustable real drag
PR 2564 / FC1 | ORIGINAL DESIGN | dimensions mm unless stated
Revision FC1 construction drawing. Prototype not yet built; calibration records blank. Dimension labels govern; do not scale.
MIT original assets. No vendor CAD. Assembly dimensions and acceptance in ASSEMBLY.md.
BRIDGE SECTION: N positive toward paper, Z vertical; extrusion span 30.
Cropped Z30..46. Red: compressed pad. Grey: post. Blue: new bridge.
Two M3x10 countersunk fasteners along N at Z40, span +/-10. Heads flush at N=-15.
Calculated normal clearance: pad 0.500; lever at Z44/theta 0.17: 0.597.
No cap screw heads in the lever gap. Inspect full angle/stroke with feelers.
DRAG: split one near-width and one rear POM carriage around its dia6 shaft.
1-wide top slit to bore; M3 cross-clamp + jam nut. Other blocks loose-running.
Adjust to target 0.60 +/-0.10 N at 20 mm/s; record breakaway and 50/100 mm/s.
Dry friction is NOT a 30 N s/m viscous damper. No physical curve measured.
Physical/model comparison must include resistance, hardware envelopes and tooth phase.
No physical or native qualification is established by construction drawings.
